# SJF4J — Overview for LLMs

SJF4J (Simple JSON Facade for Java) is a Java 8+ library offering a unified structural processing layer built on JSON semantics. It supports working directly with POJOs, Maps, Lists, JSON nodes, and extensible object models.

## Core model

OBNT (Object-Based Node Tree) models native Java values as object, array, or value nodes. APIs can work across different Java object representations without requiring an intermediate JSON tree.

## Capabilities

- **Binding:** JSON and other supported formats with pluggable backend adapters, using Runtime or generated CompiledBinder APIs.
- **Navigation:** JSONPath (RFC 9535) and JSON Pointer (RFC 6901), including read and update operations.
- **Validation:** JSON Schema validation using Runtime or @CompiledValidator APIs.
- **Mapping:** Runtime object conversion, @CompiledMapper for generated mapping, and @CompiledJdbcMapper for JDBC results.
- **Patching:** JSON Patch (RFC 6902), JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7386), and indexed deep merge.
- **Extension:** Custom node representations and value codecs.

Runtime APIs prioritize flexibility. Compile-time APIs generate specialized Java implementations where supported.

## Documentation roles

Use this summary to choose an SJF4J capability, then read the relevant guide for conceptual behavior and constraints. For exact methods, parameters, and return values, follow the guide's API Reference links to the matching Javadoc.

- [Core API Javadoc (latest published)](https://javadoc.io/doc/org.sjf4j/sjf4j-core/latest/)
- [JSON Schema Javadoc (latest published)](https://javadoc.io/doc/org.sjf4j/sjf4j-schema/latest/)

The guides may include changes ahead of the latest published release; match Javadoc to your dependency version. Guide snippets emphasize concepts and may omit imports or boilerplate.
